campaign: Structural GUI redesign (owner 2026-09-07): a flat, conversation-first interface with no card-based layout; reachable send/stop, compact model selection, mobile navigation drawer, settings on demand and relevant status only. Work exclusively in professional_overgo_gui.
doctrine: Owner direction 2026-09-07 supersedes the old card and metadata-led design. Work exclusively in professional_overgo_gui; do not integrate into master without separate authorization. Build a flat conversation surface with a bounded message area, reachable send and stop, one compact model selector with explicit details, a mobile navigation drawer, settings on demand, and status only for progress, failures or required actions. Preserve workbench capabilities. The GUI remains an embedded same-origin thin client with no build step or external assets; durable interaction and run records remain server-owned. Verify user tasks in a real browser across desktop, narrow phones, reduced viewport height and both themes. Source-size counts are review information; retain central transport, security and behavior checks. Commit through the plan-bound gate. The retained master-owned rows are protected base identities and are outside this worktree task.

items.title: Complete the pinned benchmark set for every text model, all suites except MATH

steps.title: Record MMLU-Pro (12032 cases) for every servable text model under both protocols, smallest first; the 27B runs as its own operator-launched pass with -budget 3h
steps.rationale: MMLU-Pro is the suite the model cards report, so it is the comparison that matters; it is also the largest, and the 27B at about 0.7 s per case needs over two hours. The 27B pass is launched by the owner, never unattended by the loop, and the smaller models complete first.

steps.title: Compare every recorded suite against its declared published references and the local lm-eval oracle runs, extend the reference declarations to every model that has a model card, and regenerate docs/BENCHMARK.md with a per-model comparison section
steps.rationale: A benchmark number without its reference is a bare fact; the references are store declarations with sources and protocols, and the report prints measured beside published with the protocol difference in view. MATH stays excluded and the report says so.

items.title: Verify every registered model's activated modalities against a declared expectation

steps.title: Publish the capability census: every registered model with its activated tasks, evidence tier, staleness, and on-disk presence, as a store record and a generated table
steps.rationale: The catalog holds about 28 models across 9 tasks and the verification matrix names 5; the census is the denominator every following row reports against. A stale activation is listed as stale, never dropped.

steps.title: Replace the non-empty-output smoke oracle with a declared expectation per model: an instruct model gets a chat probe with a substring oracle, a base model a likelihood floor, a domain model its domain probe; a model without a declaration is reported unverified
steps.rationale: The verified-matrix row overclaimed correctness on a liveness check; a fix surfaced by the drill is admitted under the correct-as-you-go directive. The lane's exit code is the verdict and its audit line names every model that ran without an expectation.

steps.title: Verify the chat, embedding, rerank, and vision-language activations (Qwen, gemma-4, MiniCPM, Qwen3-VL, SenseNova) through smoke-lane, cmd/embedding, cmd/rerank, and vqaparity or sensenovaparity with their declared oracles
steps.rationale: These are the largest activation group; each owner already exists and reports UNAVAILABLE when an oracle or fixture is missing. Bind the exact lane sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Verify the image and video generation activations (Krea-2-Turbo, SimpleDiffusion, Wan2.1-T2V, LiveEdit, Un-0 latent video) through the composite generation lane and latentvideo-run against the media verifier fixtures, exporting samples
steps.rationale: The media-gen campaign left measured phases, peaks, and verifier runs; this row re-runs them at the current commit so the media report reflects code that exists. Bind the exact lane sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Verify the speech synthesis (pocket-tts), OCR (Unlimited-OCR, SenseNova infographic), tabular (tabular-train-probe), series forecast, and embodied (Hy-Embodied-RxBrain) activations through their owners, each against a declared oracle or reported unverified
steps.rationale: These activations are the ones the memory notes as stale ('active recipe lacks verified evidence'); the row either verifies them at the current commit or records exactly which oracle is missing as a finding. Bind the exact owner sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Regenerate docs/MEDIA_REPORT.md from the store's verification records and link the benchmark report from it, so one generated document summarizes every model's verified modalities and benchmark rows
steps.rationale: The report is generated by cmd/compatibility -update-media from store activations and verification claims; hand-written summaries are refused. Its check is the verdict that the document matches the store.

items.title: Deliberate failure and recovery drills carried over from phase 1

steps.title: Add the rollout-plan authoring door (recipe rollout-plan: baseline, candidate, admission evidence, cohort evidence, rollback authority) that derives the cohort share and observation contract from the admission evidence, so rollout projection, quarantine re-entry, and live rollback have a committed plan to run against (finding c9c88020)
steps.rationale: Three control-plane owners parse a committed rollout plan and no command authors one; the phase-1 drill stopped on this prerequisite. It is construction admitted under the correct-as-you-go directive because the drill cannot run without it.

steps.title: Exercise circuit-breaker escalation, candidate quarantine and re-entry, rollback to the predecessor recipe, peer timeout and partial response, and workflow restart with persistent obligations
steps.rationale: The control plane's refusal and recovery paths are capability claims like any other; each has an evidence door under cmd/loop and cmd/agent-loop. Bind the drill sequence via -setverify when it starts.

steps.title: Interrupt a gate run against a scratch clone and recover through -recover-preparation, -recover-interrupted, and the watchdog
steps.rationale: The gate is the most state-bearing process in the repository -- plan mutation, commit, and store writes in one transaction -- and its recovery paths deserve the same drill as checkpoints. Bind the scripted drill via -setverify when it starts.
